description: This Java class defines constants used for configuring task executor beans within the Fineract infrastructure event external configuration module. It provides a dedicated class with a private constructor and static string constants to be used across the system.

classes.name: TaskExecutorConstant
classes.description: A utility class holding constant values related to task executor bean names, used for configuring and referencing specific executor beans in the application's context.

methods.name: TaskExecutorConstant()
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the utility class.
